data.title: Debug a Website That Isn't Responding
data.outcome: Use evidence to determine whether the failure occurs in the page, request, server, or database instead of making blind changes.
intentExamples: My saved data disappears after a refresh
My website has an error and I don't know where to look

stages.title: Reproduce the issue consistently and record it
stages.action: Write down the steps, expected result, and actual result.
stages.evidence: Someone else can follow the steps and see the same issue.

lessons.title: Frontend
lessons.tagline: The layer people directly see, click, and type into

lessons.title: Alert
lessons.tagline: Keep an important message or warning visible on the page

stages.title: Check whether the page triggered the right state
stages.action: Inspect clicks, form values, and front-end state changes.
stages.evidence: You can tell whether the problem happens before the request is sent.

lessons.title: Active
lessons.tagline: Show that a control is being pressed right now

lessons.title: Disabled
lessons.tagline: Show that a control is currently unavailable

lessons.title: Spinner
lessons.tagline: A rotating indicator that shows a short, indeterminate wait

stages.title: Check whether the request was sent and returned correctly
stages.action: Inspect the method, address, status code, and response content.
stages.evidence: You can identify whether the request was never sent, failed, or returned the wrong data.

lessons.title: HTTP
lessons.tagline: Send a request and receive a response over the web

lessons.title: API
lessons.tagline: An agreed way for two pieces of software to request and return information

lessons.title: JSON
lessons.tagline: Represent structured data as text that programs can exchange

stages.title: Use server evidence to locate processing failures
stages.action: Find the matching request log and error location.
stages.evidence: You can connect the page failure to a specific server-side record.

lessons.title: Server Logs
lessons.tagline: Record what the server did so problems can be traced

lessons.title: Route & Endpoint
lessons.tagline: Match a request path and method to the code that handles it

lessons.title: Validation
lessons.tagline: Check that incoming data has the expected shape and allowed values

stages.title: Verify that data was actually written and read back
stages.action: Compare saved records with the read request after a refresh.
stages.evidence: After the fix, refreshing the page still gives the correct result.

lessons.title: Database
lessons.tagline: Store and find application data such as users, posts, and orders

lessons.title: SQL
lessons.tagline: Ask a relational database to read or change structured records
